text.autoconfig.itemsplitter.title: Item Splitter
text.autoconfig.itemsplitter.option.enab: If true, the charge circle will be rendered
text.autoconfig.itemsplitter.option.time: Determines how long it takes to open the split screen
text.autoconfig.itemsplitter.option.spli: Determines how long it takes for the charge circle to appear
text.autoconfig.itemsplitter.option.icon: Determines which icon will render in the split screen
text.autoconfig.itemsplitter.option.enab: If true, enables the fade in/fade out animations
text.autoconfig.itemsplitter.option.anim: Determines how long it takes for the GUI to fade in/out
text.autoconfig.itemsplitter.option.star: Determines how visible the splitscreen is at the beginning of the animation (1.0 = fully opaque, 0.0 = fully transparent)
